summary: Regression test for the B2B 'trattative' bug (root cause: missing GET /api/b2b/offers/{offer_id}). Verified backend + frontend at mobile viewport 375x667 via the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass, including single-offer 200/404/auth-required, and full negotiation flow (business starts, sends message, proposes agreement → producer sees it in /mine, accepts → status agreed). Frontend: BUSINESS (business@demo.it) can open B2B, tap b2b-offer-<id>, the detail screen renders 'b2b-offer-detail' without ErrorBanner, tapping 'b2b-start-negotiation-button' shows 'b2b-negotiation-view' + 'b2b-message-input'. PRODUCER (produttore@demo.it) sees 4 items in Trattative, tapping negotiation-item-<id> opens the detail with 'b2b-offer-detail', 'b2b-negotiation-view' and 'b2b-message-list', no ErrorBanner. Icons in the negotiation detail render correctly (no crash).
action_items: None blocking. Optional: React Native web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' printed on many screens — non-blocking design refactor.
Optional: consider aligning to Ionicons v7 names project-wide; a spot check on this bug fix (handshake → briefcase/ribbon/people-outline/chatbubbles-outline/send) confirms all icons render.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/b2b/offers/{offer_id} correctly reuses get_offer() and _clean() to strip Mongo _id; auth-required via current_user; 404 for missing id.
b2b/[id].tsx correctly fetches offer via /b2b/offers/{id} and shows ErrorBanner only on real fetch failure — bug fix path is exercised.
start_negotiation is idempotent per (offer, business) — verified: retrying returns the existing negotiation, matching the client's optimistic behaviour.
respond_agreement blocks self-response and requires an existing 'proposed' agreement — good defensive checks.
seed_data_creation: None new. Test reused existing seed offer/producer 'Frantoi dei Monti Iblei'. A prior negotiation created during backend run remains in DB (business@demo.it × Frantoi offer, status=agreed) — expected and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'sezione trattative B2B dà errore' is fully resolved. Backend GET /api/b2b/offers/{offer_id} exists in /app/backend/routers/b2b.py:55-58 and returns 200 with cleaned doc. Playwright evidence: /tmp/business_offer_detail.png, /tmp/business_negotiation.png, /tmp/producer_negotiation.png. Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_b2b_negotiation.py (run with `pytest ... -o addopts=''` to avoid xdist parallel ordering that breaks class-state fixtures).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: opening a B2B offer/negotiation detail screen surfaced ErrorBanner because GET /api/b2b/offers/{offer_id} returned 404 (endpoint missing in b2b router). The frontend /b2b/[id].tsx fetches this endpoint on mount; failure → ErrorBanner. Fix (already applied by main agent): added `@router.get('/b2b/offers/{offer_id}')` handler using current_user auth + _clean() serializer, plus replaced two invalid Ionicons v7 'handshake' names in the detail screen. Regression verified end-to-end: 10 pytest cases green, Playwright smoke green for business and producer roles.
